scenario: RFCS.7a.4: when the engine withdraws a fact, whatever the cause ([RFCS.7a.2]), it records the FactWithdraw before every atom the withdrawal's evaluation produces -- the faults raised while the network re-evaluates without the fact, and the withdrawals it cascades into. The cause driven here is TTL_EXPIRED. `Gate` (ttl 1_h) blocks `ratio`'s `no Gate`, so in pump 1 `ratio`'s join on Q is never evaluated; `keep` emits `Held` logically from `Gate`. The clock is advanced past the hour and pumped: the sweep expires `Gate`. Its removal releases `ratio`'s negated pattern, the join `(p.n // q.d) > 0` runs against Q(d = 0) and traps DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, and `Held`'s only justifier is gone, so it is withdrawn with cause JUSTIFIER_ENDED. Exactly, strict: pump 1's inputs, its firing of `keep` (fact_assert of Held, action_emit); then the tick, the pump, fact_retract (Gate), computation_error, fact_retract (Held), and the drain's fault fact (fact_assert, action_emit). The first fact_retract is Gate's because nothing else can be withdrawn before Gate is: Held's cascade and the fault both follow from Gate's removal. WHICH ORDER OF THE TWO CONSEQUENCES THIS PINS: the fault, then the cascaded withdrawal -- the engine's order in both runtimes (the network re-evaluates during the removal; truth maintenance runs after it). RFCS.7a.4 admits either; this vector holds the runtimes to the one they share. PATH PINNED: libds's TTL sweep through ds_rete_wm_retract_bridge, whose recorder hold keeps a fault raised during the removal until after its FACT_RETRACT (wm_rete_bridge.c), and Mercury's sweep in ds.engine; the lockstep scenario 93_expiry_consequences (fixture 126_expiry_consequences) holds the two to each other. NOT PINNED HERE: the causes (TTL_EXPIRED, JUSTIFIER_ENDED); the stream callback's kinds carry none.
rules_ds:
schema Gate scope ttl 1_h:
    g: Int

schema Held scope logical:
    id: Int key

schema P scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    n: Int mutable

schema Q scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    d: Int mutable

rule keep:
    Gate
->
    emit Held logical id: 1

rule ratio:
    P p
    no Gate
    Q q where (p.n // q.d) > 0
->
    log info "ratio"
